- [**Viamala Raststätte Thusis**\\
\\
RestaurantThusis\\

The successful concept of the Viamala Raststätte Thusis is based on the philosophy of winning the favor of guests by using local products and serving guests with personal contact and friendliness.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/viamala-raststaette-thusis/)
- [**Viamala Gorge Canyoning with Apéro**\\
\\
OfferRongellenMay 19, 2027\\
\\
You're about to embark on an exciting beginner-friendly canyoning adventure in the Viamala Gorge. Feel the adrenaline rush as you jump through crystal-clear waterfalls and explore hidden gorges nestled between 300-meter-high cliffs.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/viamala-gorge-canyoning-with-apero/)
- [**Viamala Gorge**\\
\\
ExperienceThusis\\
\\
Descend 359 steps into the Viamala Gorge. Experience rock walls up to 300 meters high, rock cirques formed by water and historic bridges.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/viamala-gorge/)
- [**Weihnachtszauber Viamala**\\
\\
EventThusisDecember 3, 2026\\
\\
Erlebe die einzigartige Waldweihnacht der Region Viamala in Thusis. Tauche ein in eine zauberhafte Winterlandschaft mit Marktständen, Köstlichkeiten und einem vielfältigen Programm mit Musik.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/weihnachtszauber-viamala-1/)
- [**Restaurant Viamala**\\
\\
RestaurantThusis\\
\\
Enjoy a snack or dinner at the camp's own restaurant Viamala and end the beautiful summer evenings with a glass of wine or a cool drink on the terrace.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/restaurant-viamala/)
- [**Photo Spot Viamala Gorge**\\
\\
ExperienceThusis\\
\\
The Viamala gorge lies near the historical viaSpluga transit route, one of the many roads that led to Rome in ancient times. With its rugged cliffs, the kaleidoscopic play of colours on the water, and the potholes that have been cut into the rock over thousands of years, this gorge offers an unforgettable nature experience. Philosopher Friedrich Nietzsche was one of many who were fascinated by the gorge: “I shall not write about the tremendous grandeur of the Viamala. I feel as if I had not known Switzerland at all!”](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/photo-spot-viamala-gorge/)
- [**TCS Camping Thusis Viamala**\\
\\
AccommodationThusis\\
\\
Welcome to the mystical heart of Graubünden at the northern entrance to the spectacular Viamala Gorge, carved out of the rock thousands of years ago by glacial ice and the Hinter Rhine River. The campsite is an ideal stop-off on your journey to the sunny south, before you reach the San Bernardino pass. Take some time to really savour the breathtaking natural wonders of Graubünden. Sports fans will also find an almost unlimited range of activities in the surrounding area.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/tcs-camping-thusis-viamala/)
- [**Konzert Junior Band Viamala / Grischun Central**\\
\\
EventAndeerFebruary 19, 2027\\
\\
Concert by the Viamala/Grischun Central Junior Band, conducted by Stephan Liver, as well as a performance by the beginner band, “Spiel und Spass.” No registration required.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/konzert-junior-band-viamala-grischun-central/)
- [**"50 Years of the Viamala Music School" Anniversary Celebration**\\
\\
EventCazisMarch 12, 2027\\
\\
Featuring various concerts and instrument demonstrations where children, teens, and adults can try out different instruments. Small food and beverage stand. No registration required.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/50-years-of-the-viamala-music-school-anniversary-celebration/)
- [**Advent Concert**\\
\\
EventThusisDecember 11, 2026\\
\\
The Viamala Music School is celebrating its 50th anniversary this school year. To mark the occasion, students and music teachers will help set the festive mood for the Advent and Christmas season.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/advent-concert/)
- [**Dorfführung Thusis**\\
\\
EventThusisJanuary 27, 2027\\
\\
Geführter Rundgang durch den Handelsort am Eingang zur Viamala-Schlucht. Dauer 1 Stunden. Anschliessend Apéro. Anmeldung erforderlich bis am Durchführungstag 14.00 Uhr.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/dorffuehrung-thusis/)
- [**Vibrant: Juf**\\
\\
RouteThusis\\
\\
The ride between Thusis and Juf-Avers is like a demanding journey through time. After the busy traffic around Viamala Gorge, a long, steep ascent takes you to Juf-Avers, the highest (alt. 2126 m) settlement in Switzerland to be inhabited all year round.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/vibrant-juf/)
- [**ViaSpluga, Stage 3/4**\\
\\
RouteSplügen\\
\\
A cultural and long-distance hiking trail through exceptionally charming landscape. This trail is 65km long and runs from Thusis through the Viamala Gorge, the Roffla Gorge and on stone paths over Splügen Pass to Chiavenna. It is on the third leg, from the Walser village of Splügen to Isola in Italy, where you'll find the most beautiful historic remains of trails.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/viaspluga-50_03/)
- [**Alpbeizli Alp Nurdagn**\\
\\
RestaurantWergenstein\\
\\
Day guests are very welcome. Strengthen yourself with coffee and cake or a refreshing homemade syrup. We serve soup of the day, a Viamala house sausage and various platters to satisfy small or large appetites.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/alpbeizli-alp-nurdagn/)
- [**Postbus ticket between Chur and Bellinzona**\\
\\
OfferChurNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
You set off on a historically fascinating and breathtakingly scenic route by post bus. From Chur, your journey to Bellinzona takes you through the Domleschg, the Viamala Gorge, and the San Bernardino Tunnel, before concluding in the Misox.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/postbus-ticket-between-chur-and-bellinzona/)
